rows.jyutping: kei5 hai2 dou6 mou5 so2 si6 si6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for standing around with nothing useful to do.

example.english: Don't loiter around doing nothing; go inside and help.
example.traditional: 你哋唔好企喺度冇所事事，快啲入去幫手啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 dou6 mou5 so2 si6 si6 faai3 di1 jap6 heoi3 bong1 sau2 laa1
